description: Yum China uses AI to fulfill 89% of restaurant hiring needs across 16,000 stores. The implementation of this platform contributed to a reduction in restaurant manager turnover from 9.7% in 2024 to 7.8% in 2025.

instances.assertion: Yum China uses AI to fulfill 89% of restaurant hiring needs across 16,000 stores. The implementation of this platform contributed to a reduction in restaurant manager turnover from 9.7% in 2024 to 7.8% in 2025.
Yum China's AI-enabled recruitment platform fulfills 89% of restaurant hiring needs with a 1-2 week fulfillment time, and restaurant manager turnover dropped from 9.7% to 7.8%.
Yum China's AI hiring platform reduced restaurant manager turnover from 9.7% to 7.8% between 2024 and 2025.
